suggestions.reason: This is the right assertion to test the skill's differentiating output. Consider also checking that the same dimensions appear for EACH replacement (not just globally), since a single summary table that isn't per-item is arguably also insufficient.

No assertion checks that ALL six input strings received a replacement. The eval prompt presumably provided six strings; an executor that silently dropped one would still pass all five assertions. Adding a count assertion (e.g., 'at least 6 replacements are produced') would close this gap.

eval_feedback.overall: Four of the five assertions are well-targeted and discriminating — they test exact properties of the output text. The quality-comparison assertion correctly catches the missing scoring output. Consider the two suggestions above to tighten coverage.
